theorems.name: Submission.dorwbl_weighted_blowup_tendsto_at_point
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (G : Euclid n → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (v : Euclid n), (∀ x y, inner ℝ (ι x) (ι' y) = 0) → Continuous f → Measurable G → (∀ u, |G u| ≤ C) → DifferentiableAt ℝ f v → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ w in closedBall (0 : Euclid n) R, |G (v + r • w) - G v|) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → ∀ ψ : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ, Continuous ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ w, ψ (ι w + ι' (r⁻¹ • (f (v + r • w) - f v))) * G (v + r • w)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (G v * ∫ w, ψ (ι w + ι' (fderiv ℝ f v w))))
